title: Authentic Greek Salad
subtitle: Horiatiki
description: No lettuce. The feta goes on as a whole block, not crumbled — that is what makes it the real thing.

steps.text: Cut the tomatoes into thick, irregular wedges. Slice the English cucumber into thick half-moons. Slice the green bell pepper into thin rings. Slice the red onion into thin half-moons.
Arrange the cut vegetables in a large, shallow serving bowl.
Whisk together the olive oil, red wine vinegar and a small pinch of salt. Drizzle this evenly over the vegetables and toss gently.
Scatter the Kalamata olives across the top.
Place the whole block of feta directly on top of the salad bed. Drizzle a tiny bit of olive oil over the cheese block and dust the entire salad with the dried oregano.
